<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.Advanced.LogContext.ConfigureCurrentLogContextIfNull(System.IServiceProvider)">
            <summary>
            Configures the current context from dependency injection when no usable logger is present
            or an automatically configured context uses a different logger factory,
            then attaches available logging instrumentation.
            </summary>
            <param name="provider">The service provider used to resolve dependencies.</param>
            <remarks>Usable caller-configured contexts are preserved. Logger factories remain owned by their callers or service containers.</remarks>
        </member>
